info.title: E-PICSA Climate API
info.description:
### E-PICSA Climate API Documentation

* **v2 Endpoints**: High-performance endpoints querying PostgreSQL directly. [View v2 Docs Only](/v2/docs)
* **v1 Endpoints (Legacy)**: Legacy endpoints using R (`epicsawrap`) and Cloud Storage. [View v1 Docs Only](/v1/docs)

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Optional list of allowed columns. Empty means all allowed columns.

order_by.title: Order By
order_by.description: Optional sort column. Must be allowed for the selected table.

CropRecord.title: CropRecord
CropRecord.description:
Schema representing a record in the 'crop' table.
Contains agricultural crop success and rainfall metrics for a station and season.

plant_length.title: Plant Length
plant_length.description: Length of crop growing period in days

rain_total.title: Rain Total
rain_total.description: Total rainfall during crop growing period (mm)

time_stamp.title: Time Stamp
time_stamp.description: Timestamp of record creation or last update

DefinitionRecord.title: DefinitionRecord
DefinitionRecord.description:
Schema representing a record in the 'definition' table.
Defines statistical criteria, parameters, and metadata for climate summaries.

definition_id.title: Definition Id
definition_id.description: Unique definition identifier (NOT NULL in DB)

time_stamp.title: Time Stamp
time_stamp.description: Timestamp of definition creation/update (NOT NULL in DB)

definition_value.title: Definition Value
definition_value.description: JSON object containing definition parameters and thresholds

StationRecord.title: StationRecord
StationRecord.description:
Schema representing a record in the 'station' table.
Contains geospatial metadata and status for meteorological stations.

station_id.title: Station Id
station_id.description: Unique meteorological station identifier (NOT NULL in DB)

elevation.title: Elevation
elevation.description: Station elevation above sea level in meters

time_stamp.title: Time Stamp
time_stamp.description: Timestamp of record creation or update

SummaryRecord.title: SummaryRecord
SummaryRecord.description:
Schema representing a record in the 'summary' table.
Contains precomputed climate and weather statistics across time dimensions.

time_stamp.title: Time Stamp
time_stamp.description: Timestamp of calculation (NOT NULL in DB)

SummaryStationMetadataRecord.title: SummaryStationMetadataRecord
SummaryStationMetadataRecord.description:
Schema representing a record in the 'summary_station_metadata' table.
Indexes which summary types and definitions are available for a given station.

summary_type.title: Summary Type
summary_type.description: Summary type available for this station
